verdict.rationale: Dover ships a first-party MCP server that gives AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows, and it markets plain-English requests that the AI client turns into tool calls. However, natural-language operation runs only through an external AI client connected over MCP; there is no documented native in-app natural-language command interface. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions (reads vs. writes) can be performed by NL command, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask in plain English, and your AI client picks the right tool.
Set up the Dover MCP server to give AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows in Dover.
You can add Dover as an HTTP MCP server directly from your terminal.
